questions.text: Bao is the most ........................ He spends his free time doing volunteer work at the local hospital.
questions.explanation: Người dành thời gian rảnh làm việc tình nguyện tại bệnh viện địa phương là người 'sociable' (hòa đồng/thích giao tiếp xã hội).

questions.text: Mr. Nam called about his stationery order. He said Mrs. Van could.......................... him at 8 634 082
questions.explanation: Cấu trúc: 'reach someone at [phone number]' (liên lạc với ai qua số điện thoại nào).

questions.text: Nam...................... here for a week
questions.explanation: Dấu hiệu 'for a week' dùng thì hiện tại hoàn thành để chỉ một sự việc kéo dài đến hiện tại.
Thứ tự tính từ miêu tả tóc: Length (long) + Shape (straight) + Color (black) + Noun (hair).

questions.text: They are offering a 10%....................on all computers this month.
questions.explanation: Cụm từ 'offer a discount' (giảm giá/chiết khấu).

questions.text: I have several good friends but I suppose that my best (1) is Ellen.
questions.explanation: Cụm từ 'best friend' (bạn thân nhất).

questions.text: We have been friends with each other (2) we were very young...
questions.explanation: Sử dụng 'since' + mốc thời gian/mệnh đề quá khứ đơn trong thì hiện tại hoàn thành.

questions.text: We were in the (3) class at school.
questions.explanation: Cụm từ 'in the same class' (học cùng lớp).

questions.text: I don’t mind (4) she often help me with my homework!
questions.explanation: Dùng liên từ 'because' để chỉ nguyên nhân tại sao không phiền lòng.

questions.text: Anyway, I have always been better at sport than she is. I beat her at tennis... In fact, she hates (5) at anything...
questions.explanation: Hành động thua cuộc là 'losing'. Sau 'hate' dùng V-ing.

questions.text: ...she has a great sense of (6) and she always makes me laugh.
questions.explanation: Cụm từ 'sense of humor' (khiếu hài hước).

questions.text: We get on very well (7) although we have arguments...
questions.explanation: Cụm từ 'get on well together' (hòa thuận với nhau).

questions.text: ...but I (8) see her a lot.
questions.explanation: Dùng trạng từ 'still' (vẫn) để chỉ sự tiếp diễn của hành động gặp gỡ.

questions.text: We’re planning to go on a (9) around Europe next summer.
questions.explanation: Cụm từ 'go on a trip/tour' (đi du lịch/chuyến đi).

questions.text: ...because I think we’ll (10) a lot of fun and see exciting places.
questions.explanation: Cụm từ 'have fun' (vui vẻ).

questions.text:
Last week I went with my elder brother to visit our National Library. We came there early in the morning and the library was crowded with school children. It was a Saturday morning. Before our country became free, it was known as “Raffles Library”. It is said to be one of the modern libraries in Asia. The library is situated in Stamford Road beside our National Museum. There are hundred thousands of books in the library including valuable reference books, for university students.

Statement: The library was crowded when the writer came.
questions.explanation: Văn bản ghi: 'the library was crowded with school children'.

questions.text: Statement: It was a Sunday morning.
questions.explanation: Văn bản ghi: 'It was a Saturday morning'.

questions.text: British people (drink) more and more wine, apparently
questions.explanation: Dùng thì hiện tại tiếp diễn để chỉ xu hướng đang thay đổi.

questions.text: Lisa (not go) to work yesterday. She wasn’t feeling well.
questions.explanation: Dấu hiệu 'yesterday' dùng thì quá khứ đơn dạng phủ định.

questions.text: That bag looks heavy. I (help) you with it.
questions.explanation: Dùng 'will' để đưa ra một lời đề nghị giúp đỡ tại thời điểm nói.

questions.text: We (not see) Tom since we left school.
questions.explanation: Cấu trúc với 'since' dùng thì hiện tại hoàn thành ở mệnh đề chính.

questions.text: Ask him (come) in. Don’t keep him (stand) at the door
questions.explanation: 'Ask someone to do something' và 'keep someone doing something'.

questions.text: Ba isn’t old enough to ride his bike to school. -> Ba is...
questions.answer: Ba is too young to ride his bike to school.
questions.explanation: Chuyển từ 'not old enough' sang 'too young'.

questions.text: Where does she live? -> What...
questions.explanation: Chuyển từ câu hỏi địa điểm sống sang câu hỏi địa chỉ.

questions.text: Can you help me, please? -> Could you...
questions.answer: Could you do me a favor?
questions.explanation: Cách yêu cầu giúp đỡ lịch sự khác.

questions.text: “Can you turn down the radio?” Miss Jackson said to Mary. -> Miss Jackson asked...
questions.answer: Miss Jackson asked Mary to turn down the radio.
questions.explanation: Câu gián tiếp dạng yêu cầu: 'asked someone to V'.

questions.text: A bike is cheaper than a motorbike. -> A motorbike...
questions.answer: A motorbike is more expensive than a bike.
questions.explanation: So sánh hơn của tính từ đối nghĩa (cheaper vs more expensive).

questions.text: No one helped Ba draw that picture. -> Ba drew...
questions.answer: Ba drew that picture by himself.
questions.explanation: Dùng 'by himself' (tự mình) để thay thế cho việc không có ai giúp.

questions.text: We have been here since last week. -> We came...
questions.answer: We came here one week ago.
questions.explanation: Chuyển từ hiện tại hoàn thành sang quá khứ đơn.

questions.text: It’s one year since I last saw him -> I haven’t...
questions.answer: I haven’t seen him for one year.
questions.explanation: Chuyển từ 'It is time since' sang phủ định hiện tại hoàn thành.

vocab.example: Bao is very sociable and has many friends.
They are offering a 10% discount on all computers.
Mr. Nam called about his stationery order.
She has a great sense of humor.
They have organized a community meeting.
